note: Reddit blocked for crawler and Firecrawl out of credits; evidence is from web search of news/forums/reviews only. All confidence values reflect this.

ideas.name: Under-Seat 24L Pack System
ideas.concept: Rigid-edged packing cube/insert set sized exactly to the 40x30x20 cm free cabin bag, so any backpack becomes an optimised Ryanair/Wizz bag.
ideas.target_customer: Nordic and EU short-break and city-trip flyers on low-cost carriers.
ideas.problem_solved: Fitting a trip into the free bag without risking the fine or wasting space.
ideas.trend_evidence: Ryanair raised free bag from 40x25x20 to 40x30x20 cm (24 L) in 2025, still current in 2026; UK press reports bag best-sellers on Amazon but hard sales data not verified and bag category itself is crowded.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Exact-fit dimension system plus brand; inserts not bags avoids the flooded bag category; design registration of the cube geometry.
ideas.problem_note: Wizz Air also 40x30x20, supporting a de facto standard.

ideas.name: IKEA-Fit Felt Drawer Inserts
ideas.concept: Die-cut recycled-PET felt dividers cut to fit common IKEA drawer sizes (Alex, Malm, Kallax), snap-together with no plastic trays.
ideas.target_customer: Nordic flat and home dwellers who organise small-space drawers.
ideas.problem_solved: Generic plastic organisers crack, look cheap and do not fit drawer sizes.
ideas.trend_evidence: Reviews of mass drawer organisers repeatedly cite cheap cracking plastic and poor fit (Craftsman, Staples reviews); Swedish Familjeliv small-space storage threads are active. No verified rising-search data, so demand growth unproven.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Maintained fit library for named drawer models, Nordic naming, felt cutting dies (cheap steel-rule, not injection).

ideas.name: Nordic Label-and-Pouch Cable Kit
ideas.concept: Zip pouch set pre-printed in Swedish/Danish (Sladdar, Laddare, Batterier etc.) with removable elastic inserts and swappable plug-set holder.
ideas.target_customer: Households and travellers in SE/DK tired of tangled cords and lost adapters.
ideas.problem_solved: Cords, chargers and plug adapters get lost or tangled; reviewers say existing organiser cells do not fit their cables.
ideas.trend_evidence: Reviews cite cables not fitting cells, bad zippers, and loose plug adapters easily lost; Familjeliv advice recommends labelled boxes for sladdar/batterier. Category is crowded so trend is mature, not rising.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Local-language labelling and modular insert sizing; weak moat, so treat as fallback.

ideas.name: Takbox/Car Soft-Pack Family Set
ideas.concept: Set of colour-coded soft duffel cubes sized to common Nordic roof boxes, one per family member, with a packing-list card.
ideas.target_customer: Swedish and Danish families driving to mountains, cabins and camping.
ideas.problem_solved: Packing for several people into roof boxes and trunks without a shapeless pile.
ideas.trend_evidence: Familjeliv and Flashback threads recommend roof boxes and soft bags for family mountain trips and bilcamping; this shows recurring behaviour, not a verified rising trend.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Sizes engineered to specific roof box internal dimensions; Nordic family brand.

ideas.name: Daylight-Window Sill Organiser Tray
ideas.concept: Slim felt/cork tray set that sits on deep Nordic window sills and roof-window niches, designed to keep plants and clutter clear of the sash opening.
ideas.target_customer: Nordic homeowners and renters with deep sills; builds on founders' VELUX window knowledge.
ideas.problem_solved: Sill clutter blocks window opening and daylight in small flats.
ideas.trend_evidence: No verified signal found; Danish and Swedish searches returned only service/store pages. Idea is hypothesis from founder domain knowledge only.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Dimensions engineered around real window profiles and sash swing; domain credibility.
ideas.tooling_needed: Die cut or laser cut cork/felt
